headline: Food and beverage output in Kyrgyzstan reaches 108 billion soms
summary: Output of food products, beverages and tobacco in Kyrgyzstan reached 107.94 billion soms in January to October 2026, according to the national statistics service.
why: Manufacturing output in food and beverages is a measure of domestic industrial activity and consumer supply in small economies.
original_headline: Выпуск еды и напитков в Кыргызстане достиг 108 миллиардов сомов
